text:
maya: Heads-up — planning to onboard skyline-6b-lite into the model catalog tomorrow 2026-03-18 09:30 PT. Need a deploy owner and someone to run smoke checks. Any volunteers?
liam: I can own the deploy. I have a meeting until 09:45 PT though — if we start a 09:30 canary I can take over cutover at ~09:50.
olivia: I can do smoke checks + QA. Will validate latency, sample prompt outputs, and token cost. @liam share the canary weights and timing. :thumbsup:
arjun: I'll prepare the catalog pin config and rollout policy. Proposal: canary 5% for 30m, 25% for 30m, then 100% if all green. Fallback pin = skyline-6b-v2.
maya: SG. Add automation hooks: auto-rollback if p95 latency > 1200ms or error rate > 1% during a window. Also require streaming check pass.
liam: Staging smoke passed earlier. Prod deploy command (run at canary start):
```
# start canary
rb deploy catalog --model skyline-6b-lite --env prod --canary 5
```
I'll push logs to the deploy channel.
olivia: Smoke checklist I'll run during the first 20m: generate 100 queries (mixed length), check token cost delta, validate KV-cache hits, verify streaming chunking and function/tool calls. I'll paste a short summary here after 20m. Also will run this quick curl load: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"skyline-6b-lite","prompt":"<smoke-prompt>","max_tokens":64}'
```
deploy-bot: Scheduled: production deploy (canary 5%) for skyline-6b-lite by liam at 2026-03-18T16:30:00Z. Notifying oncall: @sre-oncall.
sre-oncall: I'll monitor infra and network egress. If we see memory pressure or unusual queue latency I'll signal abort and assist rollback. Ping me 5m before full ramp.
maya: After canary completes and smoke signoff, tag model in catalog as `stable:pending` and open rollout ticket with metrics. @arjun prepare the rollback commands and a one-liner runbook.
arjun: Rollback commands ready: `rb catalog pin skyline-6b-v2 --slot skyline-6b` then `rb traffic set --model skyline-6b-v2 --percent 100`. I'll attach runbook snippet to the ticket.
liam: :thumbsup: I'll start the canary at scheduled time and post a short log bundle. If anything odd, I'll abort and mark for rollback.
olivia: :eyes: I'll post smoke summary within 20m of canary start (latency percents, error rate, sample outputs). If any quality regressions we halt rollout.
maya: Thanks team. Please add any last-minute checks. I'll also update the release board with this thread link and the canary timeline.
liam: One last ask — arjun, can you pin the model version in a staging slot too so we can quickly validate traffic switch?
arjun: Done — staging pin set and tested. Ready for prod.
maya: Great. See you all tomorrow at 09:30 PT. :rocket:
